parts:
The model below is a simple zero order kinetic model that runs fine.  However,  I would like to add temperature (an array of values at each time point) but can’t for the life of me figure out how to do it.

 

What I want to do is have dydt[1] = -theta[1]*exp(-theta[2]*X) where X is a function of temperature (array or vector of values at each time point) that is part of the input data.  Right now the expression is just dydt[1] = -theta[1] as shown below.

 

Yes I could just code in the analytical solution but I plan to use more complicated ODE models that do not have analytical solutions but this is getting me started as I am trying to learn how to use the ODE capability.

 

THX
